cat > /tmp/dip-dan-reply.md <<'EOF'
Thanks, @DanIrl7 — this is a thorough and useful audit. The reproduction steps, control runs, and clear distinction between observed behavior and suspected causes are especially helpful. Apologies for the slow reply.

Yes, we'd welcome the focused PR you proposed for **Finding 1**: preserving unsaved field values and keyboard focus when the task details dialog refreshes after a background update.

Please include the browser regression check you described: enter a checkpoint draft, trigger an unrelated change in the same project, and assert that both the draft and focus survive. Please also make sure drafts stay scoped to the correct task/project and that the fix preserves normal updates to the displayed task state.

Let's keep **Finding 2** (returning focus to the originating card after closing the dialog) as a separate follow-up so the first PR stays easy to review. No need to expand this into a broader accessibility rewrite.

Please base the PR on the current `main`, use synthetic fixtures, and include your tested environment and results along with the DCO sign-off described in CONTRIBUTING.md. We haven't independently reproduced the findings yet; we'll validate the reproduction and regression check as part of review.

Thanks again for taking the time to contribute — we'd be glad to review your PR.
EOF
gh issue comment 3 --repo vxu-labs/dip --body-file /tmp/dip-dan-reply.md
